sources.excerpt: Enabled new Pages list with updated features

The new Pages list can now be enabled for any site from Experimental Features. It adds search, an author filter, page hierarchy, featured image thumbnails, a quick-create button, and a full set of page actions.

sources.claim: Compose pages screen, four tabs, pull-to-refresh, pagination, error/empty states, editor bridge
Three-character debounced search, per-author filter with persisted selection, and new-page action
Published hierarchy, depth cap, orphan promotion, and flat search/non-published modes
Status-aware menu actions, confirmations, mutations, parent selection, homepage/posts-page updates, duplicate/share/copy/Blaze
RS_PAGES_LIST appears in release-build Experimental Features while remaining opt-in
Featured media URLs resolve through the shared client and rows render a loading placeholder followed by the thumbnail
